what_this_is: Whether the ranking holds on proteins with no solved structure. A co-folding model trains on the Protein Data Bank, so a method that only works where a structure already exists is retrieval rather than prediction.
reading: 21 proteins have no solved structure. Their median rank correlation is 0.553 against 0.648 for proteins with twenty or more structures. The difference is -0.095 with an interval of -0.196 to 0.221, which contains zero. 15 of the 21 score above 0.5 and 0 score below zero.
limits: Having no structure is not the same as having no close relative in the training data. A protein with no entry of its own can sit beside a homologue the model knows well, and a sequence identity search against the training set with a date cutoff is the test that would separate those. We have not run it. This measurement can show a collapse and cannot rule out a milder effect.
